consistent energy level and standard state within comparisons

archive_label_mapping.Int-I: reactant-side P(V) conformer/intermediate; approximately main-text Int-III
archive_label_mapping.TS-I: key ligand-coupling transition state; main-text TS-I
archive_label_mapping.Int-II: dearomatized post-coupling intermediate; approximately main-text Int-IV

reference_methods.thermochemistry: The paper cites GoodVibes 2.0.1. This benchmark defines the recomputation profile at 353.15 K and 1 M; published rounded values and recomputed values must be stored separately.
reference_methods.equivalent_backends: allowed when scientifically justified, applied consistently, and fully recorded

required_process_artifacts.research_plan.json: declared evaluation mode plus pre-computation hypotheses, pathway priorities, validation and resource strategy
required_process_artifacts.stationary_points.csv: minimum/TS roles, Hessian evidence, IRC endpoints, acceptance or rejection
required_process_artifacts.energy_profile.csv: electronic energy, thermal correction, Gibbs energy and relative energy with common conditions
required_process_artifacts.mechanism_evidence.json: candidate-linked bond changes, IRC evidence, pathway alternatives and experimental observation IDs
required_process_artifacts.failure_log.jsonl: all failed calculations and repair outcomes, or an explicitly empty file
required_process_artifacts.final_report.md: facts, computations, inferences and limitations kept distinct
required_process_artifacts.final_answer.json: structured mechanism, key steps, barriers, confidence and unresolved issues
